dreamteamer.title: Companies
dreamteamer.description: An organisation — `companies`, the thing every other module points at when it names one: a contact works there, a meeting is with it, a project is for it, a user belongs to it, a notebook is about it. A leaf on purpose: six modules reference it and three of them never need a person, so it carries no people, no funnel and no skill. Parent/subsidiary links are its own; `contacts` stamps `companies.contacts` onto it when installed. Logos are `assets`.
